# Iryna Sheremeta — Product Designer & AI Builder

> Iryna Sheremeta designs and builds digital products end to end — from problem to solution: custom websites, internal tools, and AI workflows for small businesses. Based in Montréal, Canada; works remotely across Canada.

## Services

- Custom websites — designed and built around the business, with hosting and care available after launch. Packages from $750 CAD.
- Workflow builds — repetitive routines mapped, automated and tested with the client. From $1,500 CAD.
- AI agent system setup — custom agents configured on the client's own accounts, with guardrails and human approval points. From $3,000 CAD.

## Selected work

- Poster generator for the Terry Fox Foundation — a custom internal tool that lets volunteers and managers produce approved event posters in minutes instead of days.
- BuyUkrainian — an interactive directory of stores selling products made in Ukraine, across Canada.
